title: Generics with PEP 695
summary: Type parameters in brackets: def first[T], class Stack[T], type Pair[T] and a constrained Box[T: (int, str)]. Migrate TypeVar code to the 3.12 syntax, tell a bound from a constraint list, and inspect __type_params__, __value__ and __constraints__ at runtime.
